_about: The owner's calls on single UNNAMED polygons the registry's widening fold (T679 #5, owner D1: an unnamed pond a river's main flow runs through IS the river) would otherwise take into their river: each row here stays a LAKE of its own. Hand-written from a recorded owner answer only. Read by the atlas registry (`registry.flowing.load_pond_calls` -> `fold_widening_ponds(kept_lakes=)`); an atlas input (`atlas.inputs.ATLAS_INPUTS`).

ponds.water: Gagnon Creek (gnis:7733), the 58 ha unnamed lake at km 1.8-3.7, behind the rail/road embankment, joined to Williston Lake by the creek's 74 m channel
ponds.owner: Mouth is still Williston (2026-11-13, answering that FWA has the unnamed lake as its own lake, not Williston); earlier: "Let's just assume the mouth is the signs and add it as a variant name", "Where it enters Williston so it captures the whole stream"
